Tooltip_HARMONIE_MA_Bullbar: A welded steel bullbar for the front end. While driving over 10 km/h with the engine running, it has a small chance to deflect debris away from the front tires, topping up their air and condition instead of letting them wear down -- genuinely extends front tire life and reduces blowout risk, at the cost of its own condition.
Tooltip_HARMONIE_MA_WindowArmorPlate: A welded steel plate reinforcement for a windshield or door window. Built tougher than the glass it covers, so it degrades slowly on its own -- it does not restore or repair the window underneath.
Tooltip_HARMONIE_MA_CargoRack: A welded steel frame for the truck bed. Once installed, it opens up as its own secure storage container (30 capacity), separate from the vehicle's normal trunk space.
Tooltip_HARMONIE_MA_PerformanceExhaustKi: A performance exhaust and tuning kit for the engine bay. Once installed, raises engine power by up to 15% -- the bonus scales down as the kit's own condition wears down, reaching 0% extra power if it breaks completely. Shares its slot with the Stealth Exhaust and Fuel-Efficient Tune kits -- only one can be installed at a time.
Tooltip_HARMONIE_MA_StealthExhaustKit: A quieted exhaust and tuning kit for the engine bay. Once installed, cuts engine loudness by up to 40%, which directly lowers how many zombies the engine noise draws in while driving -- the bonus scales down as the kit's own condition wears down. Shares its slot with the Performance Exhaust and Fuel-Efficient Tune kits -- only one can be installed at a time.
Tooltip_HARMONIE_MA_FuelEfficientTuneKit: A fuel-metering tuning kit for the engine bay. Once installed, raises engine quality by up to 20 points, which lowers how much gas the engine burns per tick -- the bonus scales down as the kit's own condition wears down. Shares its slot with the Performance Exhaust and Stealth Exhaust kits -- only one can be installed at a time.
